messages:
jason: Heads-up — hosted-usw2 GPU-pool headroom alert spam again. ~20 alerts in the last hour, but p95 queueing hasn't changed. looks like metric jitter from image warmups.
ashley: saw that. dashboard spike corresponds to image-pull latencies. alerts firing on instantaneous headroom dip. we might need smoothing or a hold time. /cc @kelly
kelly: agree. current alert is: 
```promql
avg_over_time(hosted_gpu_headroom{pool="usw2"}[1m]) < 0.12
```
that's too sensitive. suggest: 5m rolling avg + 10m for recovery. Also add annotation to suppress duplicates.
jason: thx. can we change to `avg_over_time(...[5m]) < 0.08` and `for: 3m`?
tom: +1. also we should gate by queue-length p95 so we don't mute real issues. something like `and increase(hosted_queue_len_p95[5m]) > 0.02`
ashley: here's a proposed alert rule (Grafana):
```yaml
expr: avg_over_time(hosted_gpu_headroom{pool="usw2"}[5m]) < 0.08
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "usw2 GPU headroom low (smoothed)"
```
we can add `and (increase(hosted_queue_len_p95[5m]) > 0.01)` as a second condition.
kelly: will patch dashboard and alerting team. plan: roll change to staging now, monitor for 2h, then prod if stable. create a suppression/aggregator to dedupe alerts.
sre-bot: incident-created: #2412345680 - alert-tuning-usw2 (added by kelly)
javier: heads-up from finance — if smoothing hides genuine transient saturation we might see cost spike from fallback to dedicated. need to keep a small catching net (severity: critical) for when admission rate crosses threshold.
ashley: noted. we'll keep a critical rule with a higher threshold (e.g., headroom < 0.03 for 1m) that bypasses smoothing.
jason: ok rolling change approved. ashley/kelly to coordinate. tag me when staging change deployed :thumbsup:
ashley: deploying now to staging. `kubectl apply -f alerts/usw2-headroom.yaml` — will post status.
ashley: deployment successful, tests show no spam for synthetic jitter. monitoring for next 40m.
kelly: patched dedupe in pager duty integration. should reduce duplicate notifications. :white_check_mark:
jason: cool. follow-up: open a quick postmortem doc if we see >3 true firings in next 24h. otherwise we'll close ticket.
